notes.title: New screenshots & what’s going on
notes.notes:
Hello! 

Are you curious what’s afoot? We’ve been very busy reworking the game to reach the bar that we’ve set for ourselves. This includes better visuals: textures, models and architecture, polishing the look of the club, and more. But before we delve into the “more” part, let’s take a look at the new screenshots that show off our improved visuals & atmosphere. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41276979/6d328a9022a3017bba61ce3ca71571d31c030ba0.jpg[/img]

You see, the game we’re making is different than most “simulator” games out there. It’s much harder to create, too. The reason is that, contrary to most games from this genre, here you have tons and tons of NPCs. Not only that, but you confront them face-to-face, and they can confront each other. They can hook up, talk to each other, dance, watch others dance, and even start a fight. They can be sober or… not so sober. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41276979/5182b8ac69ce41d92087a3b1e636c81aff307667.jpg[/img]

There’s a variety of social situations, and you see them from up close, so you can’t just wing it. I can’t stress enough how much more difficult this makes the game to create than a simulator where you just renovate a building. So if you’re wondering why we need time, that’s the answer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41276979/9ae021f6facdc58e01858e1c1b18ab32dbbc1ae5.jpg[/img]

Ultimately, our goal is to deliver a game that we can be proud of. Thanks for being with us during this journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41276979/71873f09e8bc50bd7c7499cbbece1a7028784215.jpg[/img]

See you soon!

notes.title: Brewpub Simulator announced – new game coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
Quit your day job, open a bar! 

We’re celebrating International Beer Day (yes, we know it’s tomorrow) with a new game about crafting beer!

[previewyoutube=kw6uf0yrJaE;full][/previewyoutube]

Brew lagers, stouts and IPAs, and serve patrons at your own brewpub. Decorate the place, create your own brands of beer, and expand into the best joint in town. All of this in a relaxing simulator that values creativity and passion for crafting.

Wishlist the game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1755180/Brewpub_Simulator/

[list][*]Brew your dream beer! Discover new recipes, buy ingredients and unlock more advanced equipment
[*]Unlock new furniture and decorations and customise your pub
[*]Earn reputation, attract new customers and keep your returning patrons satisfied
[*]Master each step of a realistic process of brewing craft beers
[*]Play multiple minigames, including pouring beer, changing kegs, mixing ingredients, bottling beer, and more
[*]Manage your business, hire employees and keep your pub fully stocked
[*]Take on daily missions to earn more money and experience[/list]

notes.title: We have a new gameplay trailer!
notes.notes:
We have a new trailer! 

A [b]new gameplay trailer,[/b] to be precise. We do want to show you more of the game and what it looks like. Remember tho, it’s still a work in progress!

Take a look:

[previewyoutube=E07xboqHWCk;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can glimpse in the trailer, you’ll be able to [b]decorate your club[/b] to your heart’s content, including such little details like the pattern on the walls or the colour of the lights! You can buy the furniture you like (and can afford!) and place it within the grid you see on the floors, the walls and the ceiling.

When you get your club up and running, you’ll need to [b]take care of your clients’ satisfactions[/b]. You’ll make drinks at the bar (see the preview of that cool minigame? You even need to use the actual shaker!), you got to hire dancers and man the entrance. And all that’s just a fraction of all the stuff to do here.

Let us know what you think and do [b]wishlist the game[/b], it helps us a lot!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1621900/Nightclub_Manager_Violet_Vibe/

notes.title: Dev Diary part 1 – how do we make the game?
notes.notes:
Hello, Managers!

Let’s dive into Nightclub Manager: Violet Vibe… from the dev’s perspective! To bring you up to speed we decided to make a series of dev diary entries where our lead designer Mikolaj will show you what we’re working on. 

You’ll see not only the final product but the process behind making the game, the tools we use, and how it all looks when we design and test it. You can see the game through the developer’s eyes!

In the first episode we want to show you how is the game made and what will you do at the very beginning when you start the game for the first time. Take a look at the video below!

[previewyoutube=_DA0S_9txwc;full][/previewyoutube]

Hope we like what you see! Stay tuned for the next episode and in the meantime, wishlist the game! It helps us a lot.

See you!
